summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of an 8-K) furnishing a September 25, 2026 press release announcing redemption of its domestic financing bond, ISIN TRFTCEL92610. The TRY 500,000,000 nominal, 93-day bill carried a 40.25% annual simple rate (46.6931% compound), priced at 1, sold June 23-24, 2026 to qualified investors via AK Yatirim. On September 25, 2026 the issuer paid a TRY 51,277,500 coupon and TRY 500,000,000 principal. JCR Avrasya rated it AAA(tr). Watch for future refinancing issuance.
